digest.component_or_area: store event append / ticket directory creation
propositions: Ticket directory creation must stage the directory and first event file atomically to prevent interrupted-write debris (empty ticket dirs) that fsck reports as MISSING_CREATE or FOREIGN_STORE_PATH
Staging directories use dot-prefixed naming convention (.tmp-newticket-<pid>-<uuid4hex>) to remain invisible to existing fsck scanners without requiring scanner changes

StagedEvent.promote() publishes staged directory and event file together via single os.rename under write lock, preserving existing lock discipline and event invisibility until rebase guard and under_lock_check pass

All store write paths that exhibit mkdir-then-first-file-write signature must be converted or explicitly exempted with reasons: batch_stage_and_commit, inbound_translate._write_event_file, and dispatch_one BRIDGE_ALERT emission
Sweep of stale staging directories removes only .tmp-newticket-* paths owned by provably dead processes, respecting bug 043f boundary by never touching ticket directories or reader-side store data
No event format or committed layout change; byte parity preserved through shared canonical serializer
